description: Upload two photos and get a standalone before/after comparison slider as an HTML file.

faqs.a: Both images are embedded as data URLs in a single self-contained HTML file with a draggable comparison slider.
faqs.q: How does the generated file work?

faqs.a: Yes — it is one file with everything inside; just open it in any browser or host it anywhere.
faqs.q: Does the HTML file work offline?

faqs.a: No — your images stay in your browser; only the file you download contains them.

howto: Click Download HTML to save the standalone slider page.
title: Before/After Slider Maker
